goal: Speed up outbound I2P connections by skipping an unnecessary lookup round trip to the local SAM proxy
Ensure failed I2P peer lookups are accurately recorded in AddrMan rather than treated as proxy errors

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it reduces latency on outbound I2P connections by dropping a redundant proxy round trip
Ensures unresolved peer attempts are accurately logged in AddrMan instead of proxy failures
The benefits only affect nodes making outbound I2P connections and are reasonably deferrable
